s00-01-story-a0f61d.wav.text: Imagine a boss who orders you to stop working.

s00-03-story-cf85c7.wav.text: One whole day, every single week, for the rest of your life.

s00-05-grave-4aafbe.wav.text: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

s00-06-talk-2b4dfc.wav.text: Most people hear it as a list of things you can't do on Sunday.

s00-07-pivot-9cdafb.wav.text: But it started as a gift.

s01-01-story-060fc8.wav.text: Israel had just come out of Egypt, where nobody ever rested.

s01-02-story-eab0f0.wav.text: Bricks today, more bricks tomorrow, and no end in sight.

s01-03-story-b03d1d.wav.text: Now God gives them a new rhythm, with a full stop built in.

s01-04-grave-e99824.wav.text: Six days you shall labor, and do all your work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God.

s01-05-grave-13a5c7.wav.text: On it you shall not do any work, you, or your son, or your daughter, your male servant,

s01-06-grave-e59717.wav.text: or your female servant, or your livestock, or the sojourner who is within your gates.

s01-08-story-1d9529.wav.text: Sons, daughters and servants, even the animals and the foreigner.

s01-09-talk-177766.wav.text: Nobody is left working so that somebody else can rest.

s02-02-story-e78784.wav.text: In six days God made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and everything in them.

s02-03-story-f36167.wav.text: And on the seventh day, he rested.

s02-04-grave-672e1e.wav.text: So God blessed the seventh day and made it holy,

s02-05-grave-26a2b3.wav.text: because on it God rested from all his work that he had done in creation.

s02-07-story-3f477d.wav.text: Many readers take it as the rest of a finished work, not the rest of exhaustion.

s02-08-story-d9e073.wav.text: The Sabbath invites people to stop, and say: the world doesn't hang on me.

s03-01-pivot-2618e8.wav.text: Forty years later, Moses repeats the commandment, with a second reason.

s03-02-grave-9f128f.wav.text: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt,

s03-03-grave-d56c05.wav.text: and the LORD your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm.

s03-04-grave-4ce1c8.wav.text: Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

s03-05-talk-2d6d19.wav.text: Slaves don't get a day off.

s03-06-story-678652.wav.text: Their worth is how much they produce.

s03-07-story-fc17da.wav.text: So every Sabbath said it again: you are not a slave any more.

s04-01-pivot-7dd0c2.wav.text: But over time, the gift got buried.

s04-02-story-a39c07.wav.text: By the time of Jesus, some teachers had piled careful rules around the day.

s04-03-story-6e9ed9.wav.text: One Sabbath, his hungry disciples picked some grain in a field, and critics called it work.

s04-04-talk-f1be9e.wav.text: Jesus answered with a sentence that turns it right side up.

s04-05-grave-7c5517.wav.text: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

s04-06-talk-0de3cb.wav.text: It was made to serve people, not to crush them.

s05-01-talk-9f2dad.wav.text: So how do Christians keep it today?

s05-03-talk-65b30b.wav.text: Some, like Seventh-day Adventists, keep Saturday, the day Jewish families still keep.

s05-04-talk-e1c19b.wav.text: Many churches rest and worship on Sunday, the day Jesus rose.

s05-05-talk-21f921.wav.text: Others believe Jesus fulfilled it, so no one day binds, but rest still matters.

s05-06-story-54abaf.wav.text: But almost all of them agree that you were made to stop.

s06-02-talk-2ea9bc.wav.text: He offered the rest it pointed to.

s06-03-grave-01cf80.wav.text: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

s06-04-talk-d74c71.wav.text: Christians have long read this as the deepest Sabbath of all.

s06-05-story-ded4e0.wav.text: Not just a day off, but rest for the soul.

s06-06-grave-5503db.wav.text: You don't have to earn your worth.

s06-07-grave-ebd502.wav.text: You can stop, because God never does.

s06-08-story-4a2bc4.wav.text: Next time, the fifth commandment, and the people you came from.
